Problem Description
: Missing Converters in DC1
Troubleshooting
: We have reviewed the charger and it looks like we have only E17 issue in the power converter which means we have internal communication error. Please check the CAN communication cables with respect to the converter and also carry one extra spare of the cables if in case the cables are damaged. If nothing helps we recommend you to replace the power converter.
MLFB :  8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2 (Power Converter AC/DC 20kW)
